summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by B2Gold Corp., a Canadian gold producer, reporting voting results from its June 4, 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting. It discloses vote tallies on director elections, auditor appointment, restricted share unit plan approval, and an advisory vote on executive compensation, all of which passed with strong support. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, shareholder activism, or strategic changes. The filing is a routine disclosure of standard annual meeting outcomes and does not constitute a special situation event.
